schema.description: Global toast host component. Mount once near the app root. Imperative API: showToast(message, type?, duration?) exported from the module script.

showToast.description: Enqueues a toast notification that auto-dismisses after duration ms.

params.name: message
params.description: Text shown in the toast body.

params.name: type
params.description: Visual variant: 'info' | 'success' | 'error'.

params.name: duration
params.description: Display time in milliseconds before auto-close.

returns.description: No return value.

flat.title: applyLayout
flat.description: Backend RPC action: applies pixel-space width, height, stroke weight, and corner radii from the UI to every node in the current selection.

flat.title: exportPdf
flat.description: Backend RPC action: exports the ordered selection as vector PDF or flattened JPG pages. Streams pdf-progress events to the UI and returns page payloads for client-side PDF assembly (pdf-lib).

flat.title: getSelectionMetrics
flat.description: Backend RPC / stream helper: aggregates width, height, stroke, and corner radii of the current page selection for the Size PDF UI, including mixed flags and a list of items for the reorderable list.

flat.title: manageStorage
flat.description: Backend RPC action: load or save persistent plugin data via figma.clientStorage or document pluginData. Used by figmaBridge.getClientStorage / getDocumentStorage.

flat.title: resize
flat.description: Backend RPC action: resizes the plugin UI window via figma.ui.resize.

flat.title: setConstrainProportions
flat.description: Backend RPC action: sets constrainProportions on every selected node (lock aspect ratio toggle).

flat.title: OverlaysPage
flat.description: Demo tab page: toasts, MenuPopover, and confirmation Modal calling clearLayers RPC.

flat.title: ShapesPage
flat.description: Demo tab page from figma-plugin-template: create shapes via createShape RPC. Requires settings and session store props.

flat.title: TextPage
flat.description: Demo tab page: updates selected text layer via updateTextLayer RPC.

flat.title: applyLayoutChanges
flat.description: Applies width, height, stroke weight, and corner radius changes from a UI message to every node in the current Figma selection.

flat.title: canExport
flat.description: Checks whether a node supports the Figma exportAsync API and can therefore be exported to PNG/JPG/PDF.

flat.title: createRpcRouter
flat.description: Installs figma.ui.onmessage and routes incoming UI RPC calls to atomic action handlers. Successful results with a requestId are sent back via sendToUi.

flat.title: exportSelectionToPdf
flat.description: Exports the ordered selection to PDF or flattened JPG page payloads and posts progress/result messages to the UI via the provided post callback.

flat.title: figmaBridge
flat.description: UI-side reactive RPC bridge to the Figma plugin sandbox. Provides promise-based actions, canvas event streams, and Proxy-backed client/session/document storage.

flat.title: hexToFigmaRgb
flat.description: Converts a CSS HEX color string into the Figma solid-paint RGB format with channels in the 0–1 range.

flat.title: initAutoResize
flat.description: Attaches a ResizeObserver to a root DOM node and keeps the Figma plugin window size in sync via figmaBridge.send('resize'). Returns a disconnect function for cleanup in $effect.

flat.title: orderedSelection
flat.description: Filters the current selection to exportable nodes and optionally reorders them by a list of node ids (for multi-page PDF order).

flat.title: postToUI
flat.description: Thin wrapper around figma.ui.postMessage for pushing arbitrary data to the plugin UI iframe.

flat.title: radiiOf
flat.description: Returns the four individual corner radii of a Figma node. Missing corners default to 0.

flat.title: selectionMetrics
flat.description: Aggregates width, height, stroke, and corner radii across a multi-selection for the plugin UI, including mixed-value flags.

flat.title: sendToUi
flat.description: Posts a structured RPC/stream message from the Figma sandbox to the plugin UI iframe (action + params + optional requestId).

flat.title: strokeOf
flat.description: Reads the stroke weight of a Figma node. Returns 0 when the node has no strokes or does not support strokes.

flat.title: icons
flat.description: Figma-style SVG icon set from HeadMad/figma-plugin-template (105 icons). Import named exports from @figma-plugins/icons or individual files via @figma-plugins/icons/<name>.svg.

flat.title: clickOutside
flat.description: Svelte 5 attachment factory. Returns an attachment that invokes the callback when the user clicks outside the bound element.

flat.title: escapeHtml
flat.description: Escapes &, <, >, and " so a string can be safely inserted into HTML markup.

flat.title: formatNumber
flat.description: Formats a numeric value with fixed decimal precision and strips trailing zeros. Accepts the sentinel string 'mixed' for multi-selection UI.

flat.title: mergeSelectionOrder
flat.description: Merges a previous ordered id list with a fresh selection: keeps prior order for still-selected nodes and appends newly selected ones.

flat.title: moveItem
flat.description: Returns a new array with the element at index `from` moved to index `to`. Does not mutate the original array.

flat.title: parseInput
flat.description: Parses a free-text UI field into a number, the 'mixed' sentinel, or null when the value is empty/invalid.

flat.title: pxToUnit
flat.description: Converts a pixel length to a physical unit at the given print resolution (PPI).

flat.title: safeFilename
flat.description: Sanitizes a string for use as a download filename by replacing forbidden path characters.

flat.title: unitMultiplier
flat.description: Returns how many physical units fit in one inch. Used for PPI ↔ mm/cm/in conversions.

flat.title: unitToPx
flat.description: Converts a physical length (mm/cm/in) to pixels at the given print resolution (PPI).

flat.title: formPanel
flat.description: Universal form layout from the Figma plugin template: vertical stack of label+control rows, text/number inputs, color pickers, and dividers. Registered under @layer global.

flat.title: menuItem
flat.description: Styles for popover/dropdown menu rows and separators used inside IconButton popovers. Registered under @layer global.

flat.title: panelLayout
flat.description: Layout utilities for the narrow Figma-style right panel: section padding, uppercase section titles, 3-column field grid, and empty-state hint text. Registered under @layer global.

flat.title: textMuted
flat.description: Utility class for secondary/helper copy (smaller size, tertiary text color).

flat.title: normalizer
flat.description: Minimal browser reset for the plugin iframe: border-box, zeroed margins, full-size body, system font inheritance for form controls. Registered under @layer reset.

flat.title: coreTokens
flat.description: Legacy/compat design tokens for the Size PDF panel (colors, field width, icon size). Prefer figmaTokens for new work; both layers share the same CSS variable names where overlapping.

flat.title: figmaTokens
flat.description: Design tokens aligned with Figma themeColors and the Size PDF panel grid. Declares CSS custom properties for colors, typography, spacing, and radii under @layer tokens.

flat.title: Dropdown
flat.description: Compact dropdown built on MenuPopover. Options are { id, label }; selected value is the option id.

flat.title: FieldInput
flat.description: Text field with optional scrubbable prefix, matching Figma property panel inputs. Supports $bindable value and oninput/onscrub callbacks.

flat.title: IconButton
flat.description: 24×24 icon control used for settings, export, lock, and expand actions. Supports active and loading visual states.

flat.title: MenuPopover
flat.description: Trigger + floating menu popover (from figma-plugin-template). children = trigger; content snippet receives { close }. Closes on outside click via clickOutside attachment.

flat.title: Modal
flat.description: Global modal host. Mount once near the app root. Imperative API: showModal(config) / closeModal() exported from the module script.

flat.title: NumberInput
flat.description: Compact stepper control (− value +) for integer quantities. Control-only: no label wrapper.

flat.title: Popover
flat.description: Absolutely positioned floating panel. Renders children only while open is true. Click events inside are stopped from bubbling.

flat.title: PrimaryButton
flat.description: Full-width primary action button (brand blue) used for confirm/export actions inside popovers.

flat.title: RadioGroup
flat.description: Compact two-column radio group for mode switches (e.g. Vector/Flatten). Uses role=radio rows without wrapping controls in <label> (atomic UI rule).

flat.title: ScrubHandle
flat.description: Horizontal drag handle for scrubbing a numeric value. Typically placed inside a field prefix (W, H, R). Emits onscrub while the pointer moves.

flat.title: SelectField
flat.description: Styled native select matching Figma panel dropdowns. Options may be strings or { value, label } objects.

flat.title: SelectionList
flat.description: Scrollable list of selected frames/nodes with drag-and-drop reordering. Bound items array is rewritten on drop via moveItem.

flat.title: Tabs
flat.description: Tab bar + panel router built on svelte-super. Use with the exported Tab (SuperContent) children: each Tab needs an id and optional opened flag. The children snippet of Tabs receives { select, open, close, toggle, isActive, controls }.

flat.title: Toast
flat.description: Global toast host component. Mount once near the app root. Imperative API: showToast(message, type?, duration?) exported from the module script.

flat.title: Toggle
flat.description: Minimal Figma-style on/off switch. Control-only: does not wrap itself in a <label>; parent layouts supply the caption.
